entries.title: Job 27:1
segments: ¶And Job continued his parable and said,

entries.title: Job 27:2
segments: [As] *God liveth, who hath taken away my right, and the Almighty, who hath embittered my soul,

entries.title: Job 27:3
segments: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of +God is in my nostrils,

entries.title: Job 27:4
segments: My lips shall not speak unrighteousness, nor my tongue utter deceit!

entries.title: Job 27:5
segments: Be it far from me that I should justify you; till I die I will not remove my blamelessness from me.

entries.title: Job 27:6
segments: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart reproacheth [me] not one of my days.

entries.title: Job 27:7
segments: ¶Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

entries.title: Job 27:8
segments: For what is the hope of the ungodly, when [God] cutteth him off, when +God taketh away his soul?

entries.title: Job 27:9
segments: Will *God hear his cry when distress cometh upon him?

entries.title: Job 27:10
segments: Doth he delight himself in the Almighty? will he at all times call upon +God?

entries.title: Job 27:11
segments: ¶I will teach you concerning the hand of *God; what is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

entries.title: Job 27:12
segments: Behold, ye yourselves have all seen [it]; and why are ye thus altogether vain?

entries.title: Job 27:13
segments: This is the portion of the wicked man with *God, and the heritage of the violent, which they receive from the Almighty: --

entries.title: Job 27:14
segments: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword, and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread;

entries.title: Job 27:15
segments: Those that remain of him shall be buried by death, and his widows shall not weep.

entries.title: Job 27:16
segments: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

entries.title: Job 27:17
segments: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on; and the innocent shall divide the silver.

entries.title: Job 27:18
segments: He buildeth his house as the moth, and as a booth that a keeper maketh.

entries.title: Job 27:19
segments: He lieth down rich, but will do so no more; he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

entries.title: Job 27:20
segments: Terrors overtake him like waters; a whirlwind stealeth him away in the night.

entries.title: Job 27:21
segments: The east wind carrieth him away and he is gone; and as a storm it hurleth him out of his place.

entries.title: Job 27:22
segments: And [God] shall cast upon him and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

entries.title: Job 27:23
segments: [Men] shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
